BWF TV is the official channel of the Badminton World Federation (BWF), where we bring to you live, catch-up and delayed streaming of the big events on the HSBC BWF World Tour, as well as the majors like the TotalEnergies BWF Sudirman Cup Finals, TotalEnergies BWF Thomas and Uber Cup Finals and the TotalEnergies BWF World Championships. Plus enjoy a range of other exclusive content including the latest highlights and interviews as well as our top-rating magazine show Badminton Unlimited.
